In this follow-up documentary, the former subpostmasters talk about the impact of the drama and more subpostmasters come forward to tell their heart-breaking stories for the first time. These include families like the Downeys who ran a Post Office in the Lake District - when Tony was accused of theft, he moved abroad with his wife Caroline and daughter Katie to avoid the shame but recently discovered that their trauma was down to the cover-up of the faulty computer.
